command.description: First-call only. Default target is script creature reference then its world pointer; ordered character= lookups can replace/clear it. Ordered substring numeric keys share one maximum range; max_player_range latches primary-player selection and takes precedence over opponent selection even if a later max_range changes the number. Last name= chooses global world set collection; absent name uses caller packet+a8 without changing it. Ignore-assigned defaults false for next, true otherwise. Selection priority is first, next, random, farthest, nearest. First uses signed set count!=0, assigns entry0 even for negative counts, and ignores culling/reservations. Next uses the recovered EDI convention, looping/bouncing and finish flags. Primary reference is player when latched, else opponent if requested and present, else actor; optional second player supplies the second point. Caller locator base and global name collection are distinct inputs. All131 authored argument lists were exercised; runtime world population remains supplied.

native.method: Full original453aa0 with real ordered parsing/numeric resolver/name callback/set lookup/reservation refresh/selection/culling/RNG. Only bounded CRT Player%d formatting is replaced. Separate helper-order and complete region comparisons.

limits: Valid prepared runtime actor/packet/locator collections and primary player when a selector reads that position. ASCII tokens and bounded numeric operands.
Original world-owned name collection and caller-owned locator base remain distinct supplied records; attached set records may share index/owner arrays.
Managed replay pending; no live navigation/locomotion or world-loader equivalence.
